title: monty-go: Pure-Go wrapper for Pydantic's Monty Python Interpreter
summary: monty-go is a pure-Go library that wraps Pydantic's Monty Python interpreter, enabling Go applications to safely evaluate Python expressions without requiring a full Python runtime or CGO dependencies.
problem_solved: Enables Go applications to evaluate Python expressions safely and efficiently without the overhead of a full Python installation or security risks of embedding a Python runtime.
why_valuable: Provides a lightweight, secure bridge between Go and Python ecosystems, allowing developers to leverage Python expression evaluation capabilities in Go applications with minimal dependencies.
